------Applicant  VERSUS   State of Chhattisgarh through Station House Officer, PS.
 Chirmiri, District - Manendragarh-Chirmiri-Bharatpur,
 Chhattisgarh.
-------Non-Applicant
For applicant : Mr. Praveen Dhurandhar, Advocate
For Non-applicant-State : Ms. M. Asha, Panel Lawyer
SB: Hon'ble Shri Parth Prateem Sahu, Judge  ORDER ON BOARD  15/01/2024 1.

This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail, as he has been arrested in connection with Crime No.38/2023 registered at Police Station - Dornapal, District - Sukma, Chhattisgarh for the offences punishable under Section 366,
376 (A B), 376 (2) (n) of I.P.C. 1860 and Section 4, 5 (L) (M) (N) & 6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. Case of the prosecution is that, the applicant on the pretext of marriage has established physical relationship with the victim continuously from 21.03.2019 till 05.01.2023, due to which, she became pregnant and thereafter, report was lodged to the concerned police station, based upon which, the aforementioned crime was registered and applicant was arrested.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that from the period of Neutral Citation Kadti Deva vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 15 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/65498517/
1 2024:CGHC:1688 physical relationship, it is appearing that the victim was a consenting party.

entities.text: Neutral Citation Kadti Deva vs State Of Chhattisgarh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: There is no material to prove the age of the victim to be less than 18 years of age and therefore, no offence as alleged would be made out against the applicant.

4. On the other hand, learned State counsel opposes the submission made by learned counsel for the applicant and would submit that at the time of lodging of the report, victim was carrying pregnancy and therefore, she was not sent for ossification.

However, she submits that as per the physical examination report of the victim, the age of the victim was found to be 14-16 years by the Doctor posted at Government Hospital, Medical College, Jagdalpur.
5. I have heard learned counsel for the respective parties and also perused the case diary.
6. The allegation against the applicant is that, he had committed sexual intercourse with the victim since 21.03.2019 till 05.01.2023, due to which, victim became pregnant.
Perusal of the physical examination of the victim would show that she was examined by the Doctor, Department of Forensic, Medicine and Toxciology posted at Medical College, Jagdalpur.

entities.text: Department of Forensic, Medicine and Toxciology
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Based on the dental examination and the other appearances of her body, she was opined to be 14-16 years.

Doctors further mentioned that radiological examination could not be done as on the date of examination,
victim was carrying pregnancy of 08 months and radiological examination could be done after the victim's delivery.

In the aforementioned facts of the case and considering the age of the victim opined and the material available in the case diary, I do not find present to be a fit case to enlarge the applicant on bail .
7.
Accordingly, the bail application for grant of bail is rejected at this Neutral Citation 2024:CGHC:1688 stage.

Sd/-
